items.title: 6.6.2.2 Integration with Other Emerging Technologies (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Blockchain ko AI aur IoT jaisi doosri emerging technologies ke saath joda ja raha hai, jis se naye mauqe aur synergies (mil kar zyada faida) paida ho rahe hain. Yeh mel dono technologies ki salahiyat barhata aur nayi ijaadon ke raste kholta hai.

AI aur blockchain ko milane se data ki security aur shaffafiyat barh sakti hai. AI algorithms blockchain par rakhe data ka tajzia (analysis) kar sakte hain; blockchain data ki durustagi (integrity) yaqeeni banata hai, aur privacy ko nuqsan pohanchaye baghair qeemti nataij (insights) milte hain.

Misal (Example): supply chain management mein AI blockchain par rakhe mehfooz aur shaffaf data ki bunyad par demand ka andaza lagata aur maal ki naqal o hamal (logistics) behtar banata hai, jis se supply chain kaarkard aur qabil-e-bharosa banti hai.

IoT ko blockchain se jorne se IoT devices ke darmiyan data ka len den mehfooz aur shaffaf hota hai. Blockchain ki decentralized banawat IoT data record karne ke liye tamper-proof (chhed chhaar se mehfooz) ledger deti hai, jis se bharosa aur hifazat barhti hai.

Misal (Example): zaraat (agriculture) mein IoT sensors mitti ki halat aur fasal ki sehat dekhte hain aur data blockchain par record hota hai. Is se data ke asli hone ka yaqeen hota hai, aur kisan soch samajh kar faisle karte aur paidawar (crop yields) barhate hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Sochiye ke blockchain ko AI ya IoT se jorna aap ki community (ilaqe) ko kya faida de sakta hai. Classmates se baat karein aur aisa project tajweez karein jo in technologies se kisi maqami (local) masle ko hal kare.

Khulasa (In conclusion): cloud computing aur blockchain ke future trends technology mein bari tarraqi la rahe hain. Edge computing aur serverless architectures cloud computing ki kaarkardagi aur scalability barha rahe hain, jabke Blockchain 2.0 aur blockchain ka doosri technologies se mel us ke istemal aur salahiyat ko phaila raha hai. Yeh rujhanat bohat si industries ko badal denge aur nayi ijaadon aur tarraqi ke mauqe denge.

blocks.prompt: AI ko blockchain ke saath jorna data management ko kaise faida deta hai (exercise MCQ 12)? Blockchain ko AI aur IoT se jorna naye mauqe aur synergies kaise banata hai (long question 7)?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 12: (b) data security aur transparency barhati hai. IoT devices data jama karte hain, blockchain use tamper-proof aur sab ke liye qabil-e-bharosa record banata hai, aur AI us data ka tajzia kar ke andaze aur faisle deta hai. Maslan supply chain mein AI blockchain ke data se demand ka andaza lagata hai, aur khet mein IoT sensors ka data blockchain par record ho kar kisanon ko behtar faisle mein madad deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity ka namuna: blockchain ko AI ya IoT se jorne wala maqami project.
blocks.explanation: Maslan gaon mein doodh ki khareedari: IoT sensors har kisan ke doodh ki miqdar aur maeyar naapte hain, readings blockchain par record hoti hain taake adaigi munsifana ho aur record badla na ja sake, aur AI dairy ke liye aane wali supply ka andaza lagata hai. Pesh karte waqt masla, data, technology aur faida uthane wale bataiye. (Yeh sirf namuna hai, kitab mein nahi.)

items: AI + blockchain: mehfooz, shaffaf data ka tajzia (supply chain ki misal).
IoT + blockchain: tamper-proof IoT data (zaraat ki misal).
Edge, serverless aur Blockchain 2.0 industries badal rahe hain.
